headline: The little box now finishes the job by itself
lede: When the queue and feedback both run dry for mini, it no longer idles waiting for the Studio — it picks up an unowned flagship polish gap on its own, the way the Studio already did. The fleet's last idle lane is closed.

notes.text: #1372 shipped (PR #1388): mini QA earns the #878 flagship fallback — feedback dry, queue covered, studio down or busy, and a flagship gap unowned now means mini goes to work instead of idling.

Reserve shape mirrors #1290 exactly: the queue still outranks self-directed polish per tick, and a new same-tick flag keeps studio and mini off one game — one lane per gap, collisions still decided at claim time.
lanecheck grew an A9 matrix plus two warden routing pins; the mutant (reserve boundary <= flipped to <) goes red three times exactly where it should. 94 gates green, live dry-run clean.
Slot a's warden assignment #1354 was refused (slot b held it, 8 minutes old) — the claim handshake did its job and the ladder handed this session #1372 instead.
